**Pluralization:** collections are plural (`memories`, `repos`, `tags`,
`jobs`, `vectors`, `conversations`, `pipeline-failures`); a sub-resource that
is one-per-parent is singular (`code/graph/{id}`, `code/wiki/{id}`,
`vectors/projection`, `config/*`).

Known intentional gaps (document, don't fail)
**MCP endpoint is unauthenticated** — local-network-only trust model
**No rate limiting on login** — single-admin tool
**No re-embed cancellation** — batches run to completion
**Concurrent LLM config change during re-embed** has a minor race — UI-level guard only
**`count_obsolete` on huge tables** — no index on `model_fingerprint` yet
**Bulk retry runs one INSERT per memory** — acceptable for typical batch sizes
